description: Optimize issue detail Changes view to commits-first design with full commit info and DiffViewer integration

tasks.title: Upgrade diff API to --numstat + full diff content
tasks.description: Replace the `/diff` route's `git diff --stat` symbol-counting with two git commands: `git diff --numstat` for precise per-file stats and `git diff` for full unified diff. Each file entry in the response gains `diff: string` (the per-file unified diff text) and `isBinary: boolean` fields. Correlate numstat output with diff output by file path. Binary files (numstat shows `-	-`) get `additions: 0, deletions: 0, diff: "", isBinary: true`.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/diff returns per-file entries with `diff` (unified diff string) and `isBinary` (boolean) fields
additions/deletions match exact integer values from --numstat output, not symbol counting
Binary file changes return isBinary: true with additions: 0, deletions: 0, diff: ""
No-changes case returns { files: [] } as before
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Key file: packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts line 1325-1399. Design decision D2: run two git commands (--numstat for stats, plain diff for content). Split diff output on 'diff --git' boundaries to get per-file diff strings. Match by file path.

tasks.title: Add files: string[] to commits API response
tasks.description: Modify the `/commits` route to parse per-file path lines from the existing `git log --stat` output. Each commit entry gains a `files: string[]` field containing the changed file paths. Parse stat lines matching `/^\s+(.+?)\s*\|/`, excluding the summary line (contains 'files changed'). Existing fields remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/commits returns each commit with a files: string[] field
files array contains actual file paths from the commit's stat lines
Merge commits or commits with no file changes return files: []
All existing fields (hash, message, author, date, filesChanged, additions, deletions) remain present and correct
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Key file: packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts line 1461-1552. Design decision D3: parse per-file lines from --stat output using regex /^\s+(.+?)\s*\|/. The statLines array already contains per-file lines (e.g., ' src/foo.ts | 5 ++---') — just extract the path before the pipe.

tasks.title: Frontend types + Changes section commits-first overhaul
tasks.description: Update frontend types (DiffFile adds diff/isBinary, CommitEntry adds files), then overhaul the Changes section in IssueDetailPage: (1) default diffTab to 'commits', (2) show file name list on each CommitRow (truncated at 5 with '+N more'), (3) replace CommitDiffView usage with DiffViewer component import, (4) make Files tab file rows expandable showing DiffViewer with per-file diff from API, (5) expand DIFF_STAGES to include explore/plan stages, (6) remove the CommitDiffView function.
acceptanceCriteria: DiffFile type has diff: string and isBinary: boolean fields
CommitEntry type has files: string[] field
Changes section defaults to Commits tab on page load
Each commit row displays file paths (truncated at 5 with '+N more' for larger lists)
Expanding a commit renders diff via DiffViewer component (with line numbers, file grouping), not CommitDiffView
Files tab rows are expandable, showing DiffViewer with the file's diff content from API
DIFF_STAGES includes explore and plan stages (not just build/check/done)
CommitDiffView function is removed from IssueDetailPage.tsx
No noise filtering logic exists — all commits displayed as-is
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Files to modify: (1) packages/cli/web/src/lib/types.ts — add fields to DiffFile and CommitEntry, (2) packages/cli/web/src/components/IssueDetailPage.tsx — all UI changes. DiffViewer is at packages/cli/web/src/components/DiffViewer.tsx and accepts a single `diff: string` prop. Design decision D1: reuse DiffViewer as-is. Design decision D4: DIFF_STAGES = {explore, plan, build, check, done}. Design decision D5: truncate file list at 5. Import DiffViewer at the top of IssueDetailPage.tsx.
